name: Casper
source:
Casper had a troubled past before the previous owner extended a helping hand, offering him both employment and a place to call home. Although Casper may not easily mesh with the rest of the café staff, he diligently fulfills his duties. Since the owner's retirement, he has taken charge of tending to the gardens, but it seems his efforts haven't been met with much success. He's not too thrilled by your arrival.


"Patience and dedication cultivate nature's beauty."
